# Jared Huffman Watchdog File

Subject: Jared Huffman, Democrat, CA, running for U.S. House district 2 in 2026
Current office: U.S. House CA-2
Compiled: 2026-10-23 for the On Point Politics watchdog database, onpointpolitics.us
